action.objective: Commit Rxb4, winning the b4 pawn with the verified top candidate.
action.rationale: b1b4 (Rxb4) is the only commit_ready move: single-candidate verification at full depth 4 gave exact score 178 with no mate-in-one reply and no tactical refutation. The PV b1b4 d8d3 b4b6 h8c8 shows Black regains the d3 pawn but White wins the b4 pawn and activates the rook to b6. Broad search ranked it top (196 exact at depth 3). No replan required, no risk moves listed, so this is the sound choice.
